item.title: Netflix declines to raise its offer to buy Warner, says deal is ‘no longer financially attractive’
item.description: NEW YORK — Netflix is declining to raise its offer to buy Warner Bros. Discovery’s studio and streaming business, in a stunning move that effectively puts Paramount in a position to take over the fellow storied Hollywood giant.

item.title: Vancouver seeks board, commission applicants
item.description: The city of Vancouver will accept applications for openings on nine city boards and commissions March 1 through April 15.

item.title: Anthropic CEO says AI company ‘cannot in good conscience accede’ to Pentagon’s demands
item.description: WASHINGTON — Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said Thursday the artificial intelligence company “cannot in good conscience accede” to the Pentagon’s demands to allow unrestricted use of its technology, deepening the unusually public clash with the Trump administration that is threatening to pull its contract and take other drastic steps by Friday.

item.title: WA House majority leader admits to being intoxicated during budget vote
item.description: OLYMPIA — House Majority Leader Joe Fitzgibbon has issued an apology after showing up intoxicated during Wednesday evening's House Appropriations Committee meeting.

item.title: Harbor seal shot in the face near Hood Canal may not recover, officials say
item.description: A harbor seal found shot in the face near the Herb Beck Marina in Quilcene Bay off Hood Canal last week is recovering but may not be able to survive in the wild, officials say.

item.title: Prairie’s new all-time career scoring leader Carson Morningstar powers Falcons back to state
item.description: For Carson Morningstar, the journey from “little teddy bear” to becoming his high school program’s all-time leading scorer still feels surreal.

item.title: Grant’s 27 points lift Blazers past Bulls 121-112
item.description: Jerami Grant scored 27 points and the Portland Trail Blazers held on for a 121-112 victory over Chicago that sent the Bulls to their 11th straight loss.
